# AI GridWatch

> Free, sourced tools for communities facing a data center proposal: impact
> calculators, model community-benefit-agreement (CBA) language, a health-risk
> briefing, and an open tracker of 397 U.S. data center moratoriums and
> community actions across 39 states. Every number links to a primary
> source (EIA, SEC, IEA, LBNL). Not anti-development — built so communities can
> negotiate a better deal.

Full text version with current counts, definitions and latest analysis:
https://aigridwatch.com/llms-full.txt

## Open data

- [Open data hub](https://aigridwatch.com/open-data): all datasets in one place — download,
  cite, build on it. JSON/CSV, CC BY 4.0, documented schemas.
- [Moratorium tracker](https://aigridwatch.com/moratoriums): 397 data center moratoriums,
  bans, and community actions, each with a primary source, verification date,
  and derived expiry status. JSON/CSV downloads, CC BY 4.0.
- [Project tracker](https://aigridwatch.com/projects): individual data center proposals
  tracked from rumor to hearing to decision, with dated event logs.
- [Facility registry](https://aigridwatch.com/data/facilities.json): tracked data center
  campuses with operator, owner, tenant, and filing LLC.
- [State profiles](https://aigridwatch.com/data/states.json): all 50 states + D.C. —
  facility count, power draw, rates, grid carbon, water stress.
- [Deadline alerts](https://aigridwatch.com/data/alerts.json): moratoriums with documented
  end dates in the next window.

## Key answers

- [Will a data center raise my electric bill?](https://aigridwatch.com/bills): capacity
  markets, peak load, and the research on cost-shifting to residents.
- [Impact calculator](https://aigridwatch.com/impact): electricity, water, carbon, and rate
  impact for any facility size, by state.
- [Health risks](https://aigridwatch.com/health-risks): air, noise, light, bills, water,
  climate — every claim sourced, each paired with the permit condition that
  addresses it.
- [Questions to ask at your hearing](https://aigridwatch.com/hearing-questions): the
  specific questions that force answers onto the record.
- [Model CBA clauses](https://aigridwatch.com/cba-clauses): copy-paste community benefit
  agreement language with precedents.
- [Data dividend calculator](https://aigridwatch.com/dividend): the Alaska-model payment a
  community could negotiate.
- [State briefings](https://aigridwatch.com/states/): profiles for all 50 states + D.C. —
  rates, grid carbon, water stress, PUC contacts, active fights.

## Reference

- [Learn](https://aigridwatch.com/learn): how data centers work, glossary, siting basics.
- [Company scorecards](https://aigridwatch.com/companies/): hyperscaler and operator
  profiles with environmental disclosures.
- [Tax breaks](https://aigridwatch.com/tax-breaks): state-by-state data center subsidies.
- [Case studies](https://aigridwatch.com/case-studies): what communities won, lost, and
  learned.
- [About](https://aigridwatch.com/about): who runs this and how it's sourced.
